text:
QUOTE: "**Compile-time macros.** Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` in the user config." and "**Runtime hooks.** Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(calloc_fn, free_fn)`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair, but it never says they are mutually exclusive. Its table shows the macros as a separate configuration row, but that isn't an explicit exclusivity claim.
